units.source_text: 名人有另一面的表现：神经或感觉迟钝，不善于领会别人的意思，

en.t: The Master showed another side as well: his nerves or senses were dull, and he was not good at grasping what others meant,

units.source_text: 他自己所说的“发呆”，也经常表现在他的业余专长和嗜好决一胜负的做法上。

en.t: and what he himself called being absent-minded often appeared in the way he settled contests in his amateur specialties and hobbies.

units.source_text: 下将棋、连珠棋自不用说，甚至连打台球、搓麻将，他都要长时间思考，使对手觉得厌烦。

en.t: Needless to say, this was true when he played shogi or renju, but even at billiards or mahjong he would think for a long time, making his opponents grow impatient.
